findings.detail: Twenty-five positions sourced from the December 31, 2025 schedule were retained in the March 31, 2026 holdings slice.

rationale: The filing contains separate current and comparative schedules. The flagged issuers occur in the later schedule block, whose terminal total explicitly identifies it as the December 31, 2025 schedule. Retaining those 25 positions under report_date 2026-03-31 is a comparative-period contamination defect. The schedule-period label is the structural anchor; no companyfacts or aggregate fair-value triangulation is needed for this row-set classification issue.
